channel.title: GoodAIPromt
channel.description: A free AI prompt library for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney and AI video tools. Fill in the blanks, copy the prompt, get better answers. New prompts daily.

item.title: Affiliate program plan and partner recruitment
item.description: Design an affiliate program — commission model, terms, partner profile and recruitment emails — that attracts promoters who fit your brand.

item.title: AI music video scene prompt
item.description: Plan and generate atmospheric music video shots that match a song's mood, tempo and lyrics, with consistent visuals across clips.

item.title: API documentation from your code
item.description: Generate clear API reference docs from route handlers or code — endpoints, parameters, responses, errors and examples — ready for developers.

item.title: Find the brand archetype that fits your business
item.description: Match your business to one of the 12 brand archetypes and get a voice, visual and messaging direction you can apply this week.

item.title: Brand tagline options with a clear promise
item.description: Generate short tagline options grouped by style, each tied to a real customer benefit, plus a quick test to pick the strongest one.

item.title: Business continuity plan for a small business
item.description: Prepare for disruptions like outages, key staff absence or supplier failure with a simple continuity plan, contacts and recovery steps.

item.title: Find the moat that protects your business
item.description: Assess which competitive advantages your business really has, how easy they are to copy, and what to build next to stay ahead.

item.title: Choose the right chart for your data
item.description: Get a recommended chart type for your data and message, with layout, labels and colour advice — and the charts you should avoid.

item.title: Cinematic portrait with dramatic lighting prompt
item.description: Create moody, film-still portraits by choosing a lighting setup, lens, colour grade and emotion — for posters, covers and characters.

item.title: Competitor pricing research you can act on
item.description: Organise competitor pricing into a clear comparison table, spot patterns in packaging and value, and see where your price fits.

item.title: Customer service tone guide for your team
item.description: Create a support tone-of-voice guide with do and don't examples, phrases for tricky moments and rewrites of your real replies.

item.title: Reply to a GDPR data subject access request
item.description: Plan and draft a response to a personal data access or deletion request, with a checklist of steps and points to confirm with a lawyer.

item.title: Day-in-the-life documentary-style video prompt
item.description: Create a short documentary-style AI video of a maker, chef or founder at work — handheld feel, natural light and detail shots.

item.title: Debate practice partner that argues back
item.description: Practise debating with an AI opponent that presents strong counterarguments, rebuts your points and gives feedback on your reasoning.

item.title: Die-cut sticker sheet design prompt
item.description: Generate a sheet of matching die-cut stickers with white borders and a consistent style — for merch, packaging inserts and print-on-demand.

item.title: Email list segmentation plan for better results
item.description: Split your email list into useful segments based on behaviour and needs, with a message plan for each so every send feels relevant.

item.title: Executive summary of a long document
item.description: Condense a long report, proposal or research document into a one-page executive summary that leads with conclusions and decisions.

item.title: Expert interview plan to learn a field fast
item.description: Prepare for an interview with a subject matter expert — goals, smart questions, follow-ups and a note template — to get real insight in one hour.

item.title: Read financial statements in plain English
item.description: Understand an income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement — what each line means, key ratios and the questions to ask.

item.title: Fitness workout demo video prompt
item.description: Generate short gym or home workout clips with correct-looking form, clear camera angles and an energetic look for fitness content.

item.title: Fix keyword cannibalization between your pages
item.description: Find pages competing for the same keyword and decide whether to merge, redirect, differentiate or re-link them, with a clear action list.

item.title: Screener survey to recruit the right interviewees
item.description: Create a short screener survey that filters for the people you actually need for user interviews, without hinting at the right answers.

item.title: Key account plan to grow your biggest customers
item.description: Build a one-page plan for a key customer — their goals, stakeholders, risks and growth opportunities — with actions for the next quarter.

item.title: Linkable content ideas that earn backlinks
item.description: Brainstorm link-worthy content for your niche — tools, data, guides and templates — with who would link to each and how to promote it.

item.title: Local marketing plan for a neighbourhood business
item.description: Get a 90-day marketing plan for a local shop, salon, cafe or trade business, using low-cost channels that bring in nearby customers.

item.title: Luxury jewelry product photo prompt
item.description: Create premium jewelry images with controlled reflections, sparkle and props — for rings, necklaces and watches in ads and shops.

item.title: Solve math problems step by step with checks
item.description: Get a clear step-by-step solution to a math problem, with the reasoning for each step, a final check and a similar problem to practise.

item.title: Meeting agenda that ends with decisions
item.description: Plan a focused meeting agenda with a clear goal, timed topics, owners and pre-reading — or find out the meeting should be an email.

item.title: Morning routine lifestyle video prompt
item.description: A shot-by-shot AI video prompt for a calm, aesthetic morning routine clip — ideal for lifestyle brands, Reels and product placement.

item.title: Multichannel outbound sequence for B2B prospects
item.description: Plan a two-week outreach sequence across email, LinkedIn and phone, with a message for each touch that adds something new.

item.title: Client onboarding plan for service businesses
item.description: Map the first 30 days with a new client — welcome steps, kickoff, information to collect and early wins — so projects start smoothly.

item.title: Podcast cover art image prompt
item.description: Design square podcast cover art that stays readable as a small thumbnail — bold concept, clear title text and a style that fits your show.

item.title: Post-demo follow-up email that keeps deals moving
item.description: Turn your demo notes into a short recap email that confirms the buyer's goals, answers open questions and agrees a clear next step.

item.title: Prioritise your prospect list by fit and timing
item.description: Score and tier a list of prospect accounts by fit, timing signals and access, so you spend your outreach time on the best opportunities.

item.title: Write a clear problem statement for a new product
item.description: Turn a vague product idea into a sharp problem statement — who has the problem, when it happens, what it costs and how you'll know it's solved.

item.title: Programmatic SEO page template that adds value
item.description: Plan a scalable page template for many similar keywords, with the data each page needs so pages are useful and not thin duplicates.

item.title: Release notes users actually read
item.description: Turn a list of commits or tickets into clear release notes that explain what changed, why it matters and what users need to do.

item.title: Remote work policy for a small team
item.description: Draft a clear remote and hybrid work policy covering eligibility, hours, communication, equipment and security, ready for review.

item.title: Rental listing and tenant screening questions
item.description: Write a clear rental listing and a fair set of pre-screening questions so you attract suitable tenants and save time on viewings.

item.title: Reply to Google reviews, good and bad
item.description: Write personal, on-brand replies to positive, mixed and negative Google reviews that reassure future customers reading them.
